messages.subject: R-INLA error GLIBC_2.23 not found, GOMP_4.0
parts:
Hello,

when I try to run the inla function, I get the following error:

version `GLIBC_2.23' not found 

version `GOMP_4.0' not found


how can I solve this problem? 
Thank you very much

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] R-INLA error GLIBC_2.23 not found, GOMP_4.0
parts:
Hi,

you run on an old(er) Linux system. you may try

INLA:::inla.dynload.workaround()

_OR_ download the CentOS7 build at

http://inla.r-inla-download.org/Linux-builds/

read the HOWTO.

H
